police.subtitle: Recruit officers, build stations, buy equipment, raise special units and fund the security agencies. More police cut crime and unrest, but over-policing costs approval.

tiles.libertiesNone: No cost: policing is at or below the opening level

police.nationalNote: Strength is deployed officers per head × equipment, against the opening force (100%), weighted by population. Recruits go wherever the force per head is thinnest, and new stations wherever most officers have none; dismissals come from where the force is thickest. Pay comes out of the Home Affairs budget every month.
police.regionsNote: Strength is deployed officers per head × equipment, against the opening force (100%). Officers beyond their stations' capacity work at half strength. Pay comes out of the Home Affairs budget every month.
police.officersLabel: How many officers to recruit or dismiss in {{region}}
police.backToStrengthLabel: Set the officers that bring {{region}} back to full strength
police.equipmentNote: Better kit makes every officer more effective without putting more police on the street, so it costs no civil liberties.
police.topTier: The police have the best equipment.
police.unitsNote: National formations. Raising costs a one-off fee plus upkeep; disbanding saves the upkeep.
police.unitLine: {{count}} in service (started with {{opening}}) · price {{cost}} · upkeep {{upkeep}} / month
police.unitQuantityLabel: How many {{name}} to raise or disband
police.agenciesNote: Strength 0–100, starting at 50. Raising it costs a one-off fee per point and more upkeep every month; cutting it is free and saves upkeep.
police.libertiesNote: Officers per head above the opening level, and extra armed police battalions, cost approval, and the cost grows faster than the benefit. Equipment does not count.
police.libertiesRegion: {{region}}: officers per head {{value}} of the opening level
police.libertiesArmed: Armed police battalions: {{value}} of the opening number
police.runningCostsNote: Each department's allocation already pays for the opening force. What you add costs this much more every month; cuts save it.
